title: NYC, LA, and Chicago school districts are weighing alternatives to Google Search after Google declined to offer schools a version of Search without AI features (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: NYC, LA, and Chicago school districts are weighing alternatives to Google Search after Google declined to offer schools a version of Search without AI features — Google's refusal to unbundle A.I. features from search for students prompted a backlash. Now schools are looking for alternatives.
